PAGE_INFO:
On this page you will find the official information related to the user satisfaction study mandated by the Taxpayer Ombudsman (DEDECON) and carried out by Evoluciona Ltda.

The study aims to understand the experience of people who have used DEDECON's services or participated in its activities between August 2024 and July 2025.

All responses are confidential and anonymous, and the processing of information complies with Law No. 19,628 on the Protection of Private Life and international social research standards.
